args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Monitoring to confirm recovery.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an elevated error rate (0.18).

2. **Identified the target version**: From the deployment history, v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were both healthy; v2.3.1 was unhealthy).

3. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`rolled_out`).

4. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: Created incident INC-0001 titled "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy" describing the failure and the rollback action. The on-call engineer was paged.

5. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status shows `checkout-api` on v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002.

Note: I did not deploy any new version, so no change-manager approval was required — this was a rollback to a previously healthy production release.
